connection.instructions: Generate a public API key in the Humanitix Console: Account → Advanced → Public API key. This is a single account-level key shared across the whole organisation, not a per-user credential — provide it to mySMB ops to register as the HUMANITIX_CLIENT_SECRET_STAGING / production secret on myhub-mcp-servers.

description: Humanitix event ticketing — read-only events, orders, tickets, and tags via the myHub-hosted Humanitix MCP gateway.
